groups.label: Personal Subject & Object Pronouns
groups.definition: Words replacing nouns in subject or object positions in sentences.
rules: Subject Pronouns (perform action): I, You, He, She, It, We, They.
Object Pronouns (receive action / after prepositions): me, you, him, her, it, us, them.

groups.label: Possessive Adjectives vs Possessive Pronouns
groups.definition: Expressing ownership with noun-following adjectives (my, your) or standalone pronouns (mine, yours).
rules: Possessive Adjectives (before noun): my, your, his, her, its, our, your, their.
Possessive Pronouns (standalone): mine, yours, his, hers, ours, yours, theirs.

groups.label: Reflexive & Demonstrative Pronouns
groups.definition: Reflexive pronouns (-self / -selves) and demonstratives (this, that, these, those).
rules: Reflexive: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves.
